_comment: EXAMPLE. Copy to llm_providers.json and edit — the real file is gitignored,
exactly like .env. Nothing in the code names a vendor; this file is the only
place one appears, which is why it is yours to choose rather than ours to ship.
One entry = one ENDPOINT: a base_url plus the NAME of the key it reads. The
key itself never lives here — it is a Docker secret file at
vendor twice under different names with different api_key_env is how you pool
several token plans; the entries below happen to be public vendor endpoints,
and a self-hosted one is just another entry.
Whatever you register here has to be reachable by the names model_routes.json
uses, and its key has to be mounted in docker-compose.yml's `secrets:` block.
